command.extracityhall.expprobe.empty:
No grant records yet. Troubleshoot:
  1) Is the citizen actually working? (AI state name must be non-IDLE)
  2) Is primary skill level L > 0? (L=0 => ln(0/Lmax+1)=0, work can't progress; level 1 needs XP orbs first)
  3) Has L reached the 75% * Lmax cutoff? (Lmax=(home level+1)*10)
